prerequisites.reason: Artificial Neural Networks are a specific type of Neural Networks.
Backpropagation is a training algorithm specifically for Artificial Neural Networks.
Training Techniques are essential for effectively training Neural Networks.
Model Evaluation is necessary to assess the effectiveness of Training Techniques.
Classification Techniques often rely on the concept of Linear Separation.
Model Evaluation is important for assessing the results of Regression Analysis.
Optimization Algorithms are used to minimize the loss function in Backpropagation.
